text:
maria-ml: Quick triage note: hitting a deterministic divergence when we concat a long system prompt + long convo history (magnet16k, int4) with context-fusion enabled. Repro below.
jeff-quant: paste minimal repro + quant config pls.
maria-ml: run: `ENV=staging ./tests/run_longctx_repro.sh --model magnet16k --quant int4 --fuse-context true --seed 42`
maria-ml: symptom: outputs drift after ~8100 tokens; baseline (no fusion) matches expected. Logs show KV write index off-by-one.
sophie-repro: local on gpunode-12: `[warn] KV_INDEX_MISMATCH offset=8192 expected=8192 got=8193` at prefill layer 23.
jeff-quant: confirm int4-only? try int8/float16.
maria-ml: int8/float16 clean. Only int4 + fuse_context fails.
nate-eng: could be packing/stride rounding when two prefills cross a kv_shard boundary. Any rope scaling differences?
maria-ml: rope_mode was `fused_scale_legacy`. switching to `per-token-scale` didn't help.
sophie-repro: I added small dump of per-layer kv_write_index to the harness; confirms a single write to 8193 when fusion enabled. Patch on repro branch.
coda-bot: CI queued: longctx-integration (magnet16k-int4) :gear:
jeff-quant: short-term mitigation: increase kv_shard_size to 8192 for int4+fusion to avoid boundary crossings. Not a fix.
anya-sre: please file INF ticket with logs + minimal repro, add regression test to longctx-evals.
maria-ml: INF-4231 created and assigned to jeff-quant: https://redwood.internal/issues/INF-4231 :spiral_note_pad:
sophie-repro: adding note to model-onboard checklist: avoid enabling fuse_context for int4 until resolution.
maria-ml: will follow up after CI results.
